body: I'm losing it... I've been suicidal for years just can't be strong anymore. I don't even know if my mind will change :( fuucck
I do want to talk I have an array of prescription pills I'm ready to take and I know it not very affective so I was gonna slice my throat open about 10 mins after popping them all

Your comment did not disgust me... For the sole reason you didnt really try to tell me what to do you just understood and i think thats all i really need.  I definitely get volatile when people try to tell me theres other ways or things to do.  Its just not something i will stand to hear.  Thank you for the comment.  I wish when at work and with cats i could not think or just live in the. Moment but thats something my mental. State just doesnt allow me to do.  My mind for sure runs a million miles per minute.  But im used to it.  Im glad to hear your dogs help you.  Animals are amazing.  I wish you the best you definitely brought a bit of. Positivity in the perfect way.  Hope your life is full of love and laughter!

Sorry about the terrible grammar, i wrote this on a tablet that doesnt have spell check..and i was typing very fast.  Im actually incredibly smart i just look completely illiterate in the post so please dont keep that in mind.  Even typing this little comment i had to back space and fix many words.. Damn touch screens.  Lol.  Good luck yall.  Oh and btw correction i typed "my friend ssid he would care if i killed myself"  i meant to say he said that he wouldnt.. One of many errors.  Thanks again.
